sloka: ते त्वाम् अभिगमिष्यन्ति राक्षसम् योद्धुम् आहवे ।निहत्य रावणम् युद्धे हि आनयिष्यन्ति मैथिलीम् ॥४-३८-३३॥
transliteration: te tvām abhigamiṣyanti rākṣasam yoddhum āhave ।nihatya rāvaṇam yuddhe hi ānayiṣyanti maithilīm ॥4-38-33॥

translations.english: 'The monkeys who can kill ogre Ravana and his relatives in battle and bring back Maithili will be arriving shortly.
